Mummy Pig is determined that George's new hat doesn't get muddy when Peppa and George visit Grandpa and Granny Pig. Everyone tries to make sure that it stays clean, even if it means that they get messy instead.
Mummy Dog surprises Captain Daddy Dog with a gift of a boat trip for his birthday, but when Peppa and the gang come along, the trip doesn't go to plan.
Peppa and George explore the greenhouse, and it is full of lovely tomatoes and basil. When it is time for dinner, Granny Pig takes all the ingredients they have grown and makes a tasty salad.
Peppa and George go sailing with Grandpa Pig, but when he keeps getting stuck in the mud, they all decide to have a sleepover on the boat while they wait for the tide to come back in.

After Peppa and family visit a tourist spot with her new friend Birgit Bear, the caravan unhooks from the car. The bear family stops it just in time, and they finish the day jumping muddy puddles at the caravan park.
At Chloe's birthday party, the children and grownups struggle to finish the inflatable obstacle course to reach the prize.
Miss Rabbit arrives with the broken Party Bus; this is a job for Grampy Rabbit.
Peppa is playing with Candy Cat when Emily Elephant's Granny moves out of the flat. When the new neighbours arrive, Peppa recognises her holiday friend Rohan Rhino.
Peppa and all her friends are having a sleep-over, with different friends in each of the four different flats in the high street. They decide to play hide and seek across all the rooms.
The children must walk to school in a walking bus. Miss Rabbit wears a high visibility jacket, leading Peppa and friends in a bus formation.
Percy starts leaking oil from his engine, but he's too nervous to ask the others for help. Soon enough, the engine must decide between getting repairs and finishing his deliveries.
Paddington seeks the mystery hero doing good deeds, Paddington gets stuck in an igloo.

Paddington tries to find out who his favourite hero is, so he sets out with Judy. Paddington really wants to participate in a skating competition, but he can't. Until Mateo gives him a helping hand with a magical mask.

It's Halloween, but will a curse on the theatre stop the community putting on their show? Taylor the lifeguard arrives in Windsor Gardens, and just in time to save the Mooncake festival with Paddington.

It's Taylor's birthday, but he hasn't told anyone. Tom comes up with a white lie and says she has a very special gift for him. On the Scottish holiday 'Burns Night' the legend 'Haggis' walks around, and Paddington is eager to see one.
Peppa is playing with Freddy Fox at his home, in a flat above the shops. Peggy and Pandora Panda and Candy Cat live there too, and help show Peppa around.
Peppa and family help make a garden on the roof of the flats. Mr Bull assists with a big truck and crane. There is even a little something for Mrs Duck.
At the playgroup, Madame Gazelle is reading the children a story, but a page is missing so she makes up an ending. During playtime, the children make up their own alternative endings.
Rocky must rescue himself when he has been stranded on an island full of rubbish by Mayor Humdinger.
It's Halloween in Adventure Bay, and a mysterious kid in a giant spider costume is taking all the treats from the Trick-Or-Treaters.

It's Earth Day and Paddington has the important job of planting a tree. He has to find the perfect spot before it is too late. Baaz holds a spring harvest festival and everyone enjoys bringing their own celebration along.

Who is Paddington's Special Visitor that Jonathan and Judy have helped come from afar? It's the last night of Hanukkah and Mr Gruber's Hanukkiah breaks before he can light the final candle, how can another be found in time?
Windsor Gardens has two new heroes, Jonathan is hailed a hero after saving a rare gnome.
Peppa and her friends learn how to animate their drawings at playgroup.
Mum, Dad, Peppa and George decide to go to the beach on a beautiful sunny day. Suddenly, a little cloud covers the sun for a minute, but then it passes and the sun reappears.
Grandpa Pig is taking Peppa and George for a day on his boat. They meet Mr Bull who is using his digger boat to remove all the rubbish in the river that shouldn't be there.
Emilios causes trouble at the bakery in 'Snug As A Bug', then in 'Friendship Faux Paw', Annette tries to impress the town.
Rubble moves with his family of construction pups to the nearby town of Builder Cove where they live, play and build whatever the community needs.

Cat-Pack members Wild and Shade team up with the Mighty Pups to stop a runaway rocket. When the Ruff-Ruff Pack swipes a priceless golden lion mask from the museum, Wild and Shade must help the PAW Patrol retrieve the stolen artefact.
Tim tries to return a lost walkie-talkie to its owner.
Tim goes to DinoStar's training academy but is confused by his hero's training methods.
When Tim finds Blobert, an old toy, it brings out the monster in him.

Blaze is racing in the Pit Stop Power Race with AJ and Gabby as his pit crew! But Crusher is also in the race, and with his Pickle Pit Crew he's determined to win. Will Blaze take home the trophy, or will Crusher pit-stop Blaze.
Gabby gets a wishing fountain and helps make the kitties' wishes come true, but Pandy can't decide what he wants - until CatRat gets into a pickle!

When King and Queen Thistle ask Nanny Plum and the Wise Old Elf to build a boat capable of beating the Marigolds, the old rivals cannot help trying their best to outdo each other, with hilarious consequences.
Out playing in the meadow, Holly, Ben and their friends find a broken toy robot. Holly fixes it with magic, but the robot does not behave as they thought it would.

The Carnival has come to town, and it's a chance to see all sorts of exciting things! There is Mr. Bull's Jazz Band, Miss Rabbit as the Carnival Queen and even a very special appearance from Mr. Potato.

Mummy Pig's book is finished, and it's time to show it off to Peppa and her playgroup friends. Unfortunately, Peppa and George lose some of the book when they are playing, and Mummy Pig has to think quickly to fix it.
Peppa's family are at Digger World, where they have fun building walls and knocking them over again, and even help Mr Bull when there's an obstacle in the road.
Teddy needs mending and cleaning after rolling down hills and jumping in muddy puddles, so Peppa takes her to Miss Rabbit's Doll Hospital.
Daddy Pig and Mr Bull are digging up the playground, so Daddy Pig decides to teach the kids some simple science. The first experiment is to see how many children it takes to pick up Madame Gazelle.

It is school project time for Peppa and her friends, which means they have to build castles and bring them into playgroup. Mummy and Daddy Pig have lots of fun helping Peppa make hers, if only they could find the glitter.
When the police visit the school, officers Panda and Squirrel teach Peppa and her friends all about bicycle safety.
The youngsters visit the zoo where they are shown around by zookeepers Mr Lion, Mrs Crocodile and Mr Giraffe.
Smurfette and Grouchy compete to determine who is the best. Blossom dreams of travelling to Mars and can rely on her friends for support.

When a windstorm sends a polar bear cub down to Adventure Bay, it's up to Ryder, Everest, and the pups to bring the baby bear back to its family; the Pups must save Mayor Humdinger from a runaway movie projector.
Mayor Humdinger hijacks Al's big rig. Al's load of big pipes breaks loose.
Rosa kicks Stan out of the park in 'The Stan plan', then in 'Earth Day Games', it's the Earth Day Games at school.
The fairy kingdom is left without food because there is nothing left in the treasure chest to pay the elves. As money doesn't grow on trees, King Thistle has to find a job.
Ben and Holly meet a new friend, Betty Caterpillar, but she is sad that she can't join in their games because she can't fly.
Poor Gaston the ladybird has never had a birthday party, but this changes when King Thistle finds out.
Naughty Gaston is sent to pet school, where Miss Jolly soon gets him into shape.
It is a day for practical jokes, but Tim does not know when to stop.
Grandad's gnomes go missing. The mystery deepens when Stan finds a tiny human handprint! The gnomes can't really have come to life, can they?!
Pockets has a wonderful dream but soon after she wakes, she's forgotten it.
Clarion learns to take time for himself in 'Frog Day Afternoon', then in 'Hare There and Everywhere', the trainees use their senses.
Peppa, George and Freddy Fox are mistaken for pirates while sailing on the river with Grandpa Pig. When the truth is revealed, officers Panda and Squirrel invite them for a ride in their police boat.
At the climbing centre, Grampy Rabbit teaches the children about mountain climbing. For the really high climbing wall, Grampy attaches safety ropes to the children so they don't fall.
Mummy, Daddy, Peppa and George go to the park. Peppa and George play on the hopping logs, the bouncing branch and the monkey bars.

Madame Gazelle takes the class through a simple tots workout at Peppa's playground that uses spinning hoops. Though they have fun playing with the hoops, they have a hard time spinning them around their waists as directed.
The pups leap into action when Digi and Tal's coconut catapult goes out of control and rockets off through the jungle targeting birds and monkeys. A baby goose hatches in Humdinger's lair.

Cap'n Turbot tells the tale of how he learned to speak fluent alien while shipwrecked with an Alien Grandpa! A lemon-loving baby duckling from Yumi's Farm gets mixed up in a delivery to Lizzy's Lemonade Shoppe.
When Gabby and Pandy find a magical jar of googly eyes, they're in for a trouble-making surprise; luckily, MerCat knows just how to burst trouble's bubble.
Peppa and her friends visit the cinema for the first time to watch the 'Super Potato' film.
The children decorate the clubhouse to make it scary for Halloween, but not too scary.

Peppa and George go bird watching with Grandpa Pig. Peppa quacks like a duck, George coos like a pigeon, and they all have great fun filling in Grandpa Pig's book. Grandpa wants to see a cuckoo, and suddenly he hears one calling.
Inspired by Granny Pig's stories of ancient Rome, Peppa and George decide to design the mosaic of a dinosaur with pebbles, and learn a little Latin.
Mummy Pig suggests the family all make pizzas together, so everyone prepares and chooses the food to make their own individual pizzas.
Peppa and her friends visit Mrs Badger's petting farm, where they enjoy feeding the chickens and meeting cute guinea pigs.
Peppa and George visit a restaurant for the first time to celebrate Grandpa's birthday. They have a great time asking for everything they would expect at a party.

Granny and Grandpa Pig have been growing strawberries to make jam, but the birds have eaten all the fruit. They decide to go and pick their own at Miss Rabbit's strawberry farm, but Granny and Grandpa eat too many strawberries and end up very full.
King Thistle does not want to get any older so decides that no one must celebrate his birthday, but all the Little Kingdom has been waiting to celebrate.
Holly and Ben help the Wise Old Elf play a trick on Nanny Plum for Elf Joke Day, but she does not see the funny side and gets her revenge by turning the Wise Old Elf into a giant snail.
While Kana and Thomas deliver aquarium materials for the Vicarstown Fish Day, it's up to steady Percy and Nia to deliver the fish themselves.
On their way to a celebration for Thomas' 10,000th delivery, Percy tries to help Thomas with his big speech, but Thomas fails to listen.
Tim, Tommy and Tia do all they can to stop Grandma leaving, so they can spend more time with her.
Tim, Tommy, and Tia find a lost toy and vow to return it to its owner.
Tim searches the kitchen, reads labels and ingredients to find a hogweed-free snack for Kai.
Paddington and Simi go on a magical journey into the human body.
Peppa is playing at Suzy's house, and they find out that Granny Sheep is moving in. She transforms the dull spare room and attic into an exotic boudoir and creative studio for her to make things.
On a rainy day, Granny Sheep plays in the garden with Peppa and Suzy. They decide to play with cardboard boxes and build a hospital, a cookie factory, and a train station.

Peppa and her friends are at the clubhouse. They are playing at serving takeaway food. The children assign themselves different roles, including a cook and a waiter. Once the imaginary food is ready, they have fun delivering it.
Peppa and George play with walkie-talkies at Granny and Grandpa Pig's house. Grandpa Pig teaches Peppa and George how to use codenames to talk using the gadgets.
Peppa is intrigued to see her parents go to work every day. Daddy Pig makes Peppa her very own office to make her feel good.
Peppa finds a small bird on the ground in the garden of her house. She takes him to Dr Hamster, who explains that it is a swift and is probably tired after a long journey.

Peppa and her family are visiting Cousin Chloe's house to play with Baby Alexander. Peppa thinks she knows all about babies because she already looks after her doll, and George is a baby too, though he disagrees.

At the playground, Pedro and Penny's glasses fall off; both think that their glasses are broken, as they cannot see very well; Madame Gazelle shows Pedro and Penny different types of objects with lenses.
Out looking for Gaston, after banning him from the castle, the elves and fairies come across a speaking door which leads to the dwarf mine. Once in, they find they can't get out.
A gang of squirrels appear at the Great Elf Tree. They are determined to store their acorns inside, but the Wise Old Elf has a cunning plan to stop them.
Mummy and Daddy Pig take Peppa and George to a castle to feast on medieval banquets, play King and Queen, and even meet a dragon. It is George's favourite day ever.
When the school roof is broken and needs fixing, Peppa volunteers Mummy Pig to do a parachute jump to raise money. Daddy Pig goes up too, and has to overcome his fear of heights.
A new student, Gerald the giraffe, joins the playgroup where Peppa and her friends go. However, when he tries to fit in, he finds it difficult to play hide-and-seek because he is so tall.
Miss Rabbit takes Peppa and the family to Granny and Grandpa Pig's house to drop off their shopping, but that's not the last trip of the day for her.

Peppa and her family oversee the building of a large remodel to their home to accommodate the new baby, but things go awry when Daddy Pig's blueprints get swapped for George's plans for a robot house.
With the building work complete, it's time to decorate! Peppa and George have fun choosing how to decorate their new attic bedrooms. It's dinosaurs for George, but what will Peppa pick?

Peppa and her family are going for a drive. Suddenly their car breaks down, and it has to go to Granddad Dog's garage to be fixed. While their car is fixed, they borrow a shiny new, blue car from Granddad Dog.
Granny and Grandpa Pig are taking Peppa and George to a festival, a jigsaw festival. Peppa learns the secrets of puzzles from Grandma Donkey.
Judy finds her inner hero on the Rangers Camping trip as they need to shelter from the weather; Paddington befriends a speedy snail with a heroic future ahead, but also looks so sad.
Paddington and Robot Paddington enjoy being heroes, Paddington discovers how to be calm.
On a cold day, Daddy Pig suggests they build a den until Mummy Pig has finished work. After a hard day's work, the cushion den is a perfect place to watch TV together!
Auntie, Uncle Pig, and cousin Chloe are coming for dinner and Peppa is allowed to join too! Peppa is very proud of staying up late; she even stayed up later than the Daddies!
Peppa and family are watching TV, until it breaks! While Grampy Rabbit fixes it, the family get a new TV which can do everything, but it doesn't beat their old TV.

When a storm cancels Peppa and her family's outdoor adventure plans, they decide to bring the fun indoors. Using their imagination, they go sledding, climb a mountain and enjoy a campfire in the attic.
Peppa and George play in their pool, helping garden animals cool off. When rain arrives, both the animals and Peppa are pleased. The rainfall forms muddy puddles, which Peppa loves for jumping.
Peppa and George visit Granny and Grandpa Pig's garden, where Granny's friends are playing folk music. After they perform for Grandpa Pig, he treats everyone to freshly made apple juice.
It is bedtime and Peppa calls Kylie Kangaroo and is surprised to learn that it is not morning or winter where she is! Daddy Pig explains this using a big ball to represent the Earth.

While visiting Suzy and Emily's house, Peppa is surprised that there are extra rules which she does not have in her own house. On the drive home, Peppa explains to Mummy Pig that different houses have different rules.
Mummy Pig is confirming she is having a new baby. Mummy and Daddy Pig share the exciting news with Peppa and her brother, George.

Peppa and family are on the search for a new home but after all the house viewings, nothing beats their home. Peppa then suggests they extend their house instead, so the family design a bigger house together.
Madame Gazelle is making a wicker basket. She explains it is her hobby - something you do to relax. The children discuss hobbies and learn about each other's favourite things to do.
Mummy Pig and Peppa are at Granny Pig's house. They find Mummy's old patchwork quilt that Granny made for her as a baby. Peppa decides she'd like to make one for the baby!
Peppa is out with Suzy and Granny Sheep in Mummy Sheep's car. They come across an old van that Miss Rabbit is recycling. Granny Sheep decides she would like to turn it into an art van.
Peppa and her friends, accompanied by Mummy Sheep and Granny Sheep, take Vanessa to Grampy Rabbit's boatyard for inspiration. The children create various artworks using items found around the yard.
While Mummy and Daddy Pig attend a refresher antenatal class, Peppa and George join Miss Rabbit's Sibling School where they learn about what to expect when their new sibling arrives.
Peppa eagerly awaits her new sibling, growing impatient with the lengthy wait. Suddenly, Mummy Pig announces that the baby is coming right now.
The Pig family go to the hospital, where Peppa is determined to find the perfect name for the baby.
The nurse visits and decides to focus on teaching proper baby-holding techniques. She demonstrates a safe method for a small person, like Peppa, to hold an infant correctly.
George undergoes a medical examination to assess his hearing. The results of the test reveal moderate hearing loss in his left ear, marking an important milestone in his health and development.
Peppa is excited to help George explore the world of sounds now he has his hearing aid. She shows him her favourite sounds including the splashing of jumping in a muddy puddle!
It's raining, and Peppa is sad because she cannot play outside. However, when the rain stops, Peppa and George get to play one of their favourite games, namely jumping in muddy puddles.
George is upset when he loses his favourite toy, Mr Dinosaur. Peppa becomes a detective to track it down.

Peppa's best friend, Suzy Sheep, comes to play at Peppa's house for the afternoon. Peppa won't allow George to join in. When Peppa and Suzy want to play doctors and nurses, George is delighted to be the patient.
Peppa and George visit Granny Pig, who is very excited about her new pet, a parrot called Polly.
Paddington wants to make a special cake. Paddington and Mateo form a table tennis team.
Sir Joshalot and the knights are on a quest to find a special treat for the afternoon snack feast.
Holly invites Ben to the annual Royal Fairy Picnic. King Thistle hopes there won't be a repeat of last year's magical jelly flood.
Holly and Ben think Gaston the Ladybird is sad so they try and cheer him up by tidying his cave, but Gaston liked his cave just as it was, all messy and untidy.
Holly needs her wand to do magic, but one day Holly loses her wand, and is very sad.
Holly goes with Ben and Mr Elf to the elf farm to collect an egg for the King's breakfast. While there a huge chicken escapes from the farm and Holly and the elves have to chase it.
Peppa and George are playing hide and seek, but Peppa complains that George is too easy to find.

George joins Peppa at her playgroup today. Peppa doesn't really want George to be there. It's her playgroup after all. Then George is an instant hit with all of Peppa's friends. They think he's 'brilliant'.
Peppa and George love helping Mummy Pig work on her computer, but they like playing computer games more.
Peppa teases George because he can't catch a ball properly. Mummy Pig suggests they play a game that will help George learn how to catch, called 'Piggy in the Middle'.
When Daddy Pig loses his glasses he gets a bit grumpy, but Peppa and George have lots of fun looking for them.
Peppa and George enjoy helping Grandpa Pig plant seeds in his garden.

George eats his breakfast too quickly and gets hiccups, so Peppa tries to help him get rid of them. After trying everything else, there is only one solution left for Peppa to cure him with - to scare him!
Peppa's friends are all riding their bicycles. Peppa is determined to learn to cycle without her stabilisers after she teases George about having a baby's tricycle.
Josh and Blue have a play date with Rainbow Puppy and play a special game to figure out where she wants to go.
Paddington takes off and becomes the world's first Bearonaut; Jonathan, Judy, and Paddington pick all the blackberries in the garden, but Mr. Curry seems to think some are his.

After breaking Papa Smurf's telescope, Monkey wants to make up for his mistake by fetching him a star. Handy wants to assemble a team of experts to retrieve his jetpack from Gargamel, but the Smurfs he has in mind aren't available.
Holly and her friends must stay in the courtyard and play with Holly's little twin sisters Daisy and Poppy. All is fine until the twins borrow a magic wand and escape from the castle.
Queen Thistle has a beautiful new teapot that is so delicate that no one is allowed to touch it. Holly accidentally breaks the Queen Thistle's teapot and tries to fix it with Ben's help.
Peppa loves secrets, so Mummy Pig makes her a special box to put secret things in.
Peppa, George, Mummy and Daddy enjoy flying a kite in the park until their kite gets tangled in a tree beside a big, muddy puddle.
When Daddy Pig and Mummy Pig are tidying up the house, they happen to find an old box of musical instruments. George makes a loud sound with the Swiss horn.
Peppa and George discover frogs, worms and butterflies in Granny Pig and Grandpa Pig's garden, and they play with them. Then Peppa, George and Grandpa have fun jumping in muddy puddles.
Peppa and George make everyone laugh when they dress up as Mummy and Daddy Pig.
Peppa gets shiny new red shoes and never wants to take them off, until it's time to jump in muddy puddles.
Peppa and the Pig family attend a school fête. Peppa's favourite things at the fête are face painting, the balloons, and the bouncy castle.

Peppa, George and Daddy Pig are excited about Mummy Pig's birthday and have lots of fun preparing surprises for her. When Mummy Pig sees her beautiful cake and opens her present, she is absolutely delighted.
Holly accidentally turns Ben into a frog. With the help of her friends, Holly tries to turn Ben back into an elf but instead turns him into a bird and then a rabbit.
Holly spends the day with King Thistle on his royal duties. King Thistle must launch an elf boat, judge a fairy fruit competition and make a speech at the festival.
Ben and Holly are having fun playing in the meadow. Holly gets frustrated when Ben uses his elf skills to win all the games, and Ben gets frustrated when Holly uses her magic skills.
King Thistle has a cold and needs some medicine. Nanny Plum, Holly, and Ben, have a lot of fun collecting the ingredients to make a magic potion to cure his cold and make him better.
Everyone's in the Cat-O-Ween spirit; Gabby and Pandy make cat-o-lanterns with Baby Box, search for treats with MerCat, and make banana ghosts with Cakey.

After Peppa's tooth falls out, Mummy Pig explains that the Tooth Fairy will come that very night to take the tooth and leave a shiny coin in its place. Peppa plans to stay awake all night to see the Tooth Fairy.
Grandpa Pig hides some pirate treasure in his garden, and when Peppa and George come, they have to look for it, using a map and following the clues.
Peppa is feeling unwell and Doctor Brown Bear says she must stay in bed. Peppa's friends come to cheer her up.
Peppa and George have fun in the snow, as they make footprints, snowballs and build a snowman.

Peppa and her family go on a day trip to visit the Windy Castle. Mummy Pig drives, while Daddy Pig reads the map. When they reach the destination, Peppa and George spot Granny and Grandpa Pig's house.
Peppa's older cousin Chloe comes to visit, and Peppa must play games by somebody else's rules for a change.
Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig are going out for the evening. Granny and Grandpa Pig babysit Peppa and George. They are too excited to sleep. When Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig get home everyone is asleep.
Mayor Humdinger makes a mess when he steals paint from Rubble's cousin Mix; two mountain goats cause trouble at adventure bay's hot springs.

Chickaletta is left driving the train after an enormous chicken floaty launches Engineer Ed out the window. When Katie needs to close the Pet Parlour early, Digi and Tal volunteer to keep the shop open.
Ben, Holly and Gaston the Ladybird find a large egg in the meadow. A tiny chick hatches from the egg and the children must find the mummy bird.
Ben is in training for the elf games, and Holly wants to join in but the rules state there is absolutely no flying or magic allowed. Ben gives Holly a chance to join in without using magic.
Nanny Plum is teaching the fairy girls some important fairy rules when she is blown away, trapped in a tree, dropped in a stream and covered in mud.
The Elf Factory is deep down in the roots of The Great Elf Tree. It is almost Christmastime and the elves are busy making toys for the holidays. Some magic saves the day when there is a problem.

Peppa goes to her first ballet lesson, and meets her friends Candy, Suzy, Rebecca, Danny and Pedro there. She decides to teach Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig to dance but finds out they have some moves of their own.
Peppa and George are playing in the garden when they hear a strange noise. It's thunder. Peppa and George are a little bit frightened at first but Peppa soon decides that she loves thunderstorms.
Daddy Pig is taking everyone for a drive in the country, but the car is very muddy and Mummy insists they wash it first.
When the family goes to Granny and Grandpa Pig's house for dinner, George is reluctant to eat his salad.
Peppa and family go camping, but soon realise that their tent is too small for everyone, so Daddy sleeps underneath the stars.
It's bedtime, but Peppa is not sleepy, so Daddy Pig tells Peppa and George a story about a pretty princess and a dinosaur.
Peppa and George have a fancy dress party and all their friends are invited. Peppa dresses as a fairy princess and George as a scary dinosaur.
Peppa and her family visit a museum, and Peppa likes the Kings and Queens room, whereas George's favourite is the dinosaur room.
Mr. Brown talks about selling the house, the kids make a prickly discovery in the garden.

The PAW Patrol must rescue Mr. Porter and reunite an ostrich family before the big birds get into big trouble; During Mayor Goodway's fashion show, the pups must save Farmer Al and Mayor Humdinger after Humdinger's puffy shirt floats away with them.
A French fry mascot needs help after being carried away by a flock of hungry seagulls; Mayor Humdinger tries to steal the Adventure Bay lighthouse.
Peppa and George want to jump in muddy puddles, but Mummy tells them to go in the pool instead.
Peppa and her family visit Uncle Pig, Aunty Pig and Cousin Chloe. Chloe has a new puppet theatre, and she helps Peppa and George to make puppets. After lunch, they put on a very funny puppet show.

Daddy Pig loves to watch television, but Peppa Pig thinks that he needs to do some exercise. She says that Daddy Pig's tummy is looking a bit big. Daddy Pig disagrees but says that Peppa can be in charge of getting him fit. Peppa gives him lots of exercises to do, and Daddy Pig is exhausted by the end of the day.
Peppa and George have to tidy their bedroom. After a frenzy of cleaning, the room is tidy, but the room doesn't stay tidy for long though.
Peppa and George are at the playground with their friends. Peppa loves to play on the swings, but George is a bit afraid of heights and doesn't like to be pushed too high.
Mummy Pig has a lovely new picture of Peppa and George, so Daddy Pig offers to put it up, but it's not as simple as Daddy Pig thought, and he makes a very big hole in the wall.
Peppa and George love going to the beach on sunny days. They bring their water wings, a beach ball and buckets and spades. Peppa and George have fun burying Daddy Pig in the sand.
George finds a very friendly spider in the bathroom. Peppa is very frightened until she realises that the little spider doesn't want to hurt her. She names him Mister Skinny legs.
Crusher unleashes three of his most destructive and terrifying creations on Axle City, and only Robot Blaze is strong and powerful enough to save the day.
Count Josh-ula and Blue the Bat go to the farm for a day of Halloween festivities. We play Blue's Clues to find the Jack O'Lantern in the pumpkin patch!
The playgroup visits a nature reserve, specialising in tiny insects, bugs, and butterflies. So Pedro brings along his pet stick insect.
George and Peppa spend the day playing golf with Grandpa Pig, but they are much more interested in the colourful mini-golf course next door.
Peppa learns that Mummy Pig used to keep a diary when she was her age, so Peppa decides to give it a try.
Miss Rabbit's Rescue Service has saved many people from tricky situations, but what happens when Miss Rabbit needs rescuing herself.
Peppa and her friends play some very active games in the garden.
Police Officer Panda and Police Officer Squirrel visit Peppa's playgroup. They offer two lucky children the chance to spend the day with them.
Mummy Pig shows Peppa how to play pretend by teaching her how to wink. Zoe Zebra comes to play with Peppa and brings along her toy monkey. Peppa pretends Monkey has a cough.
Peppa and George wake up in Granny and Grandpa's motorbike tent by the sea. Peppa finds a message in a bottle with a telephone number on it.
Grandpa and Granny Pig dust off their motorbike and sidecar to take Peppa and George on a trip. They go to the beach and camp in a tent that folds out of the sidecar.

Peppa and family make it to Hollywood, but they need to find the movie studio where Super Potato and Hash Brown are making the film 'Vegetables in Space'. They get lost on the motorway, but another Miss Rabbit tells them to follow the stars, which turn out to be stars in the pavement.

Peppa and family continue driving across America to get to Hollywood. As they drive through the desert, they meet Mr. Buffalo and Mr. Bison who are doing road work just like Mr. Bull from back home. They meet another Miss Rabbit and fly over the Grand Canyon in a helicopter, white water raft through the rapids and discover a cave from 700AD.

Peppa and family are driving in their large campervan across America to get to Hollywood. They stop at a diner to ask for directions and meet another Miss Rabbit. She sings them some songs and cooks them some eggs, over easy, of course, then they go to a barn dance followed closely by watching a Monster Truck rally, expect lots of muddy puddles.

Peppa and her family win a trip to America to star in Super Potato's movie, "Vegetables in Space". Miss Rabbit flies them over, and they land in New York only to meet a new Miss Rabbit who shows them around the city of New York. They go up the Empire State Building and see the lights in Times Square. Now they have to get to Hollywood.
Grampy Rabbit teaches Danny Dog and Peppa why his lifeboat is so important when it comes to saving lives at sea and gives them tips on how to stay safe.
Mr. Curry is sure there's a monster in the park lake, and Paddington sets out to help him prove it.

Carly ist unachtsam beim Überqueren der Straße und übersieht ein Auto. Freddie kann sie in letzter Sekunde wegschubsen und verletzt sich selbst dabei. Carly verliebt sich in ihren Lebensretter. Sam und Spencer spielen inzwischen Paintball.

Im Büro des Portiers Lewbert findet Sam eine Kiste mit persönlichen Gegenständen. Die Freunde finden eine DVD, die von Lewberts Ex-Freundin Marta erstellt wurde, und wollen Marta mit Lewbert wieder zusammenbringen.

Sam hat früher an Misswahlen teilgenommen und will ihrer Konkurrentin Leanne nicht gegenübertreten. Sie simuliert einen Wutanfall und zwingt Carly, an ihrer Stelle bei der Wahl zur Miss Teen Seattle anzutreten.

Zum ersten Mal kann Carlys Papa die Show live sehen. Da Sam im Knast ist, muss Carly Ersatz finden. Spencer, der zeitgleich ein Date mit Candice hat, will Carly helfen. Doch das endet darin, dass Candice schreiend wegläuft.

Carly erhält das Angebot, ins All zu fliegen, um eine Webshow zu senden. Doch vorher muss sie eine Trainingswoche mitmachen und ihren Konkurrenten aus dem Weg räumen. Doch dann stehen 36 Stunden auf engstem Raum an.

Gibbys Hund wird für die Show aufgepeppt und fotografiert. Das Studio wird zum Tierfotoladen. Doch dann tauchen die Petografen Oliver und Stewart auf und drohen den Kindern Ärger an, wenn sie das Studio nicht wieder umbauen.

Eine Hitzewelle erreicht Seattle und nach einem Stromausfall sind alle Menschen ohne Klimaanlage. Doch Spencer schafft es, eine Klimaanlage aufzutreiben und in Gang zu setzen. Doch das bleibt nicht unentdeckt und immer mehr Gäste klopfen an.

In der Krossen Krabbe tauchen immer wieder anonyme Mitteilungen am Anschlagbrett auf, die unter den Angestellten für Unmut sorgen. Diese Nachrichten führen zu Verwirrung und Misstrauen unter den Mitarbeiter:innen. Die harmonische Arbeitsatmosphäre wird dadurch erheblich gestört.
Um zu einer Food-Messe zu kommen, muss die Krosse Crew sich in der Wildnis durchschlagen. SpongeBob muss den Schein wahren, als ihn ein Brieffreund besucht, den er vorher angeschwindelt hat.

Thaddäus ist wütend und eifersüchtig auf Siegbert Schnösel, der in einer Fernsehshow auftaucht. Plankton wird aus dem Gefängnis entlassen und hat schon wieder einen geheimen Plan. Er will sich mit SpongeBob anfreunden, aber nicht ohne Hintergedanken.

SpongeBob findet einen Cent auf der Straße. Mr. Krabs beobachtet ihn dabei und will den Cent klauen. SpongeBob will unbedingt in einer Nacht alles über die Geschichte der Seefahrt lernen. Aber bald stößt er an seine Grenzen.

Plankton entscheidet sich, statt seines Restaurants nun eine Kampfarena zu führen. Er lockt damit sogar die Gäste der Krossen Krabbe an. Thaddäus will beim Kompositionswettbewerb gewinnen, aber SpongeBob kommt ihm in die Quere.

SpongeBob will gerne normal werden und trainiert dafür fleißig. Aber das hat Folgen, die nicht nur positiv sind. Seine Burger sind auf einmal auch nur noch durchschnittlich lecker. Eines Morgens sind alle Einwohner aus Bikini Bottom verschwunden.

SpongeBob hat einen Splitter in seinem Daumen und kann jetzt nicht mehr richtig arbeiten. Er will aber auf keinen Fall früher nach Hause. SpongeBob und Patrick spielen auf Lotusflöten, zu deren Klang sich alle Meerestiere bewegen müssen.

Larry ist der Held der Goo-Lagune und lebt nach dem Motto: Lebe wild und gefährlich. SpongeBob und Patrick versuchen das auch. SpongeBob und Patrick wollen so braun werden wie Rocky Mammalton und greifen zu radikalen Mitteln.

Tim, Tommy und Tia finden ein verlorenes Spielzeug und versuchen, es zu seinem Besitzer zu bringen. Kai freut sich darauf, mit dem Nebulator zu fahren, aber Tim ist sich unsicher. Tim und Kai wollen den Weltall-Käfer fotografieren.

Dora und Boots suchen das Schiff der Piratenschweinchen und retten es vor dem Kraken. Dora und Boots helfen dem Häschen Bruno, seinen eigenen Tanzstil zu finden, um bei der Show seiner Lieblingsband, den Bunny Boyz, zu glänzen.

Um Lori zu helfen, besorgt ihr Luan einen Job im Bohnen-Café, dessen Chefin Luan ist. Lana wird derweil von Lily verfolgt. Sie schafft es nicht, ihre kleine Schwester loszuwerden, die ihr überallhin wie ein Schatten folgt.

Als Lucys Kristallkugel Lynn eine triste Zukunft zeigt, versucht Lynn, ihr Schicksal selbst in die Hand zu nehmen. Lincoln, Clyde und Kara konkurrieren um die Chance, ThumbZ zu treffen und sein neuestes Spiel testen zu dürfen.

Lynn freut sich auf den Besuch von ihrem Schweizer Freund Henrik, doch als alle denken, sie seien mehr als Freunde, wird sie nervös. Lincoln und seine Freunde bieten an, Schnee zu schaufeln, um Geld für David-Steele-on-Ice-Tickets zu verdienen.

Ellie und die Kinder gehen der seltsamen Mrs. Withers auf die Spur. Doch als Jack plötzlich verschwindet, müssen Ellie und Lily ihn retten. Lily und Jack wollen auf die Seite des Bösen wechseln und tun sich mit Chuck zusammen.

Lily zeigt Jack den Vergnügungspark Lake Island. Als sie dort festsitzen, droht ihre Freundschaft zu zerfallen. Will möchte seine Beziehung zu Jack festigen und bei Mike A's ein neues Bett für ihn kaufen. Doch sie erleben dort ein Abenteuer!

Schere, Stein und Papier versuchen, ihre Tradition aufrechtzuerhalten, jeden Moonami-Film am Premierentag zu sehen. Das Trio landet vor einem Spinnenrichter und einer Jury, weil es versucht hat, eine Spinne in seiner Wohnung zu zerquetschen.

Stein fordert Schere zu einem Bowlingspiel heraus, bei dem es um viel Geld geht. Als Stein bei einem Persönlichkeitsquiz das schlechteste Ergebnis erhält, versucht er allen zu beweisen, dass er weiß, wer er wirklich ist.

Zum Glück hat SpongeBob ein selbstfahrendes Boot - dazu braucht er keinen Führerschein. Außerdem steht Patrick unter dem Eindruck, ein alter Mann zu sein. Also muss SpongeBob an den Spaß erinnern, den man nur als Kind haben kann.

1. Geschichte: Was für ein Winzlings-Wahnsinn! SpongeBob und Patrick erfreuen sich an Miniatur-Ausgaben ihrer selbst! 2. Geschichte: Plankton hat ein Problem: Er hat seiner Oma Glauben gemacht, ihm gehöre die Krosse Krabbe. Nun da sie zu Besuch kommen will, muss er die Lüge aufrechterhalten.

Patrick trifft ein Monster und freundet sich mit ihm an. Natürlich lernt auch SpongeBob das Monster kennen und findet es ebenfalls super, allerdings ist es tollpatschig, was die Bürger der Stadt verärgert. Bikini Bottom gerät in ein Bermuda-Dreieck.

Eine alte Dame bittet Mr. Krabs um einen Rabatt für einen Krabbenburger. Doch der lehnt ab. Die Dame belegt den Laden daraufhin mit einem Fluch. Es passieren seltsame Unfälle und die Gäste bleiben weg. Mr. Krabs und SpongeBob müssen etwas tun.

Ronnie Anne und Sid sind entschlossen, herauszufinden, ob es sich bei der neuen Mieterin um ihre Lieblingswrestlerin La Tormenta handelt. Nachdem ein alter Mann Carls Gokart gewonnen hat, will Carl beweisen, dass er den Preis selbst verdient hat.

Als Carl Rosas Pantoffel an sich nimmt, gerät die Ordnung in der Stadt aus den Fugen und die Macht des Pantoffels wird entfesselt. Zudem begeben sich die Carlitos auf ein wildes Abenteuer, um ihr Lieblingsspielzeug im Spielzimmer zu finden.

Die Schwestern bitten Lincoln, den Meister der Überzeugungsarbeit, ihnen beizubringen, wie man Eltern am besten um Geld bittet. Weil Lisas Bericht zeigt, dass sie soziale Fähigkeiten verloren hat, muss sie sich einen Freund suchen.

Als Luan hört, wie ihre Geschwister die Komödie kritisieren, an der sie arbeitet, beschließt sie, diese aufzugeben. Die Kinder wissen, dass Leni Überraschungen oft kaputt macht. Sie halten also die bevorstehende Party vor ihr geheim.

Lincoln und sein Vater gehen zu "Legends of the Hidden Temple" und freuen sich darauf, gemeinsam Zeit zu verbringen. Außerdem will Lincoln einkaufen gehen, muss aber auf seine kleine Schwester aufpassen. Also nimmt er sie einfach mit.

Squidward muss herausfinden, wer es getan hat, nachdem ein mysteriöser Fremder Mrs. Puffs Fahrschule verwüstet hat. Squidward nimmt an einem Gartenwettbewerb teil, hat aber Mühe, mit SpongeBobs natürlichem grünen Daumen mitzuhalten.

SpongeBob wird eine Gruppe von Elfen einfach nicht los, die sich für eine gute Tat unbedingt bei ihm revanchieren wollen. // Ein Pantomime beginnt, SpongeBob zu folgen (und ihn nachzuahmen). Das geht SpongeBob auf die Nerven.

Plankton tauscht mit Thaddäus den Körper, um die Formel zu stehlen, muss sich aber an seine neue Gestalt gewöhnen. Sandy bringt SpongeBob Cowboy-Fähigkeiten bei. Sie suchen Blubberblasen-Seife, während Krabs ihnen als Schatzjäger folgt.

Als Schere einen Tannenzapfen verschluckt, nutzt Bleistift einen Origami-Roboter, um in seinen Magen zu gelangen. Schere sieht einen Film über einen Underdog, der trotz aller Widrigkeiten Football-Star wird, und versucht es ihm gleichzutun.

Patrick Star hält in seiner Wohnung mithilfe seiner exzentrischen Familie eine Talkshow. Dabei treten allerlei schillernde Charaktere aus Bikini Bottom auf - von altbekannten Freunden bis hin zu völlig neuen Persönlichkeiten.
Patrick überzieht bei den SquarePants und nutzt das Haus für seine Show. SpongeBob hilft Squidina.

Als Pinky auffällt, dass sein Vater keinen besten Freund hat, macht er sich auf die Suche nach einem. Pinky hat einen neuen Job als Eintüter. Den nimmt er so ernst, dass er dem ersten Kunden im Namen des Kundenservices bis nach Hause folgt.

Lincoln und Clyde müssen die seltene Orchidee von Howard ersetzen, nachdem sie sie überwässern. Lynn Senior ist sehr aufgeregt, denn er nimmt an einer Fernseh-Kochshow teil. Doch es stellt sich heraus, dass er dabei gegen Rosa Casagrande antritt.

Lincoln erstellt eine App für die Familie, um damit die Haftnotizen seiner Mutter zu ersetzen. Damit soll die Familie den Zeitplan besser im Auge behalten können. Um ein neues Fahrrad kaufen zu können, gründet Lana eine Autowerkstatt.

Die Kinder wollen Myrtle mit ihrer Vergangenheit bloßstellen, bevor Pop Pop ihr einen Antrag macht. Lynn und Liam geraten in der Schule aneinander. Denn sie werden dazu gezwungen, bei der Aufsicht in der Schule zusammenzuarbeiten.
Die Mitarbeiter der Krossen Krabbe bauen zusammen ein Boot für ihren ehrgeizigen Kapitän.
SpongeBob arbeitet im härtesten Lokal der Stadt, Karen kümmert sich um Fleckchen.

Sandy verteilt am Baumfesttag spezielle, von ihr gezüchtete, Salzwasserbäume an all ihre Freunde in Bikini Bottom. Es stellt sich jedoch heraus, dass sie bald viel zu gut unter Wasser wachsen. Es gilt nun, dem Wildwuchs Herr zu werden.
Plankton versucht, an die Geheimformel heranzukommen, indem er sich an SpongeBobs Zunge festklebt.
Plankton tritt dem Bündnis B.Ö.S.E. bei; SpongeBob, Patrick und Thaddäus in die Tropen fliegen.

Als Thaddäus wesentlich die Post von Nosferatu erhält, wagt er sich zu dessen Burg. Währenddessen verbringt Slappy, der Assistent von Nosferatu, etwas Zeit alleine. In der Zeit besucht er Bikini Bottom und ist dort zu Besuch.

Roboter bewohnen in einer alternativen Realität die ganze Stadt Bikini Bottom. Mr. Krabs baut ein neues Telefon in der Krossen Krabbe ein, doch es ist verflucht. Opa Patrick reist in der Zeit zurück, um nach Hause zu finden.
Jasper's enthusiasm leads him to send Captain Man and Kid Danger into incidents that aren't crimes. When he's falsely accused and sent to jail, Henry and Ray must get him free.
When Captain Man finds himself trapped underground, Henry must devise a way to sneak out of his school's standardised testing to save Ray.

Nearing their 100th save, Phoebe and Max are determined to make it their best and most memorable one yet. But by ignoring a series of small saves they overlook a super villain plotting revenge on his old rivals, Hank and Barb.

As Sarah and Gideon's crushes on Max and Phoebe escalate, the twins set them up on a date with each other to solve the problem once and for all. However, when Max discovers Sarah's uncle is a rock star, he wants to win her back.
Carly is ready to accept not going to the annual dance, when someone shows up to take her. Her night takes another unexpected turn when she is asked a life-changing question.
Stan sees Twister eating fish and hides a tracker in one, so he knows Twister's every move. Thanks to the Marsupilamis, Jade looks like an expert at parkour with Mica filming her moves.

Jade helps Mica, Suzanne and Bibi, but quickly becomes overwhelmed and struggles to prevent chaos at Chahuta. The Marsupilamis miss the delivery man and chase after him to retrieve an important package.
Gargamel turns himself into a snail, so Farmer will bring him back to the Smurfs' Village.
Gargamel clones himself to capture all one hundred Smurfs. The Smurfs unwittingly ask Dimwitty for advice when he gets stuck in a tree.

When Chef sprains his ankles after a fight with Greedy, he's left without anyone available to take his souffle to the upcoming Spring Festival. Greedy offers his help, but Greedy can't be trusted to not chow down the souffle.
Squidward's amazing new life is threatened. Stuck in her dome, Sandy suspects Plankton's up to no good and gets Patrick to investigate.
SpongeBob must go to extremes when Gary refuses to go to the vet. SpongeBob gets stuck while working out.

When Scissors lies about Rock's birthday to get free cake, the trio must go on the run; when Paper lies to impress his neighbour, Pencil, he winds up having to defend the world from an alien invasion.

Ever wonder what it's like to grow up in a big family? Eleven-year-old Lincoln Loud gives viewers an inside look at how to survive the chaos of a huge household, especially as the only boy with ten sisters!
While Boss Baby is away, interim manager Staci must fend off three challenges -- from Pyg & Tam, OCB and Bug the Pug.
Patrick house-sits for Granny Tentacles; the Dartfish adopt Plankton.
SpongeBob and Squidward try to sell Krabby patties from a food truck in the darkest depths of the ocean. Pearl and Narlene have a whales' day out in the big city.
Plankton joins the League of E.V.I.L.; frustrated that he's seen as cute instead of evil, Plankton builds a robot to punish anyone who says "aww."
Animal detectives Sam and Kit collect all the clues while searching for the slithering suspect who bit an express train's engineer.
Animated, Children, Action, Adventure, Science, Educational
The Deer Squad release evil Baron Bite and his minions from their icy prison. Sir Steel and the Squad battle Baron Bite with the help of Professor Scratch but who will win?
It's time to light up the night with a glow-in-the-dark delivery; Gabby, Pandy and DJ Catnip get to work on a train-building project.

Gargamel turns himself into a snail, so Farmer will bring him back to the Smurfs' Village; when Blossom gets into a fight with Storm and Lily, she leaves her village and moves into the forest with Wild.
The Krusty Krew get lazy when their mums take over the Krusty Krab. Patrick's new pet rock catches the eye of a mischievous rock collector.

The gal pals become unstoppable after Sandy teaches them karate. Before long, the entire town has got in on the action. Plankton infiltrates a party thrown by Karen for her computer friends, but Karen quickly uncovers his ruse.
Tinkle time travels. Bunny and Cecil celebrate Spend Time With One Of Your Kids Day.

When Lily begins digging to discover why her favourite ice cream van is selling shaved ice, she uncovers a town-wide conspiracy. Dirk is wrongly accused of stealing a Canyon Valley landmark, so Min comes out of retirement as a lawyer to help him.
A power outage gives two rebels a chance to break into a lab where the Chaos Council is studying Sonic's strange connection to their energy source.
Unruly baby Scooter Buskie sends shock waves through the playgroup organisational chart and all of babydom when he lands the cover of the Bubbeezee catalogue.
The Chum Bucket is replaced by a flower shop with a charming new owner; the Krusty Krab enters a float in the annual Bikini Bottom Parade.
Sandy's homemade snack becomes a big hit at the Krusty Krab; SpongeBob and Patrick's favourite comedy duo has a falling out on live television.
Sonic meets his match in Chaos Sonic, a robot version of himself designed to never fail. Meanwhile, the Chaos Council decides to expand their empire.
Quasar uses Patrick to communicate with Aliens; Patrick and Grandpa have a contest about staring off.
EVIL challenges SpongeBob to deliver to their secret lair in ten minutes or less. When Mr Krabs becomes trapped inside Pearl's new boat, he must pretend to be its engine to avoid being caught.
On the first day of middle school, Lydia and Julie's big plans to become the most popular girls in school are thwarted when Addison effortlessly steals the limelight.

On her 14th birthday, Taylor Young receives a chest from an uncle who disappeared five years ago leading her on an adventure with her mother Emily, a marine biologist, her stepfather Sunny and her half-sister Lila.
A symbol leads Taylor and her friends across Rock Island to find Uncle Charlie's missing plane. However, they remain unaware that someone else is after the missing treasure and is hot on their trail.
Sal and Anika discover a mysterious stone near the house. Determined to find out more, they head into the forest in search of clues, only to realize they are not alone.
Sal and Anika meet a nervous boy in the forest who reveals a secret they never would have expected.
Alfie fails to corrupt Eddie's pictures with a virus, so Nina decides it's time for plan B: Fabian must persuade Joy not to run the story. Joy agrees, on one condition.
Fabian tries to kiss Joy - but to Nina's delight he can't go through with it. Joy agrees to drop the article anyway. Amber and Alfie confront Jerome and learn the awful truth.
On learning the truth about Rufus' return, the Sibunas confront Jasper and persuade him to meet The Collector and offer him a counterfeit mask while the Sibunas rescue Trudy.
Vera has locked the Sibunas in the barn and Alfie stages a rescue, but the dollhouse gets crushed and Trudy knocked unconscious, forgetting everything when she comes round.
Charlotte and Jasper must come to the rescue when Captain Man and Kid Danger are each stuck in a hole.
When Dr Minyak takes the Man Fans hostage, Captain Man and Kid Danger have to find a way to rescue them without Dr Minyak seeing them move.

Taylor and her friends meet Faraz, an old friend of Uncle Charlie, who has discovered the Fountain of Youth. The group attempt to find out if it is connected with Uncle Charlie's mysterious disappearance.
Max wakes up in his new foster home to discover his foster parents have vanished. Max and his new brothers and sisters embark on an adventure to find them.
The Hunters stay home from school to search for their missing parents and find more than they were expecting in the Hunter House Library. Anika leads a museum tour.
After fighting with her mother, Sam moves in with Carly, who soon realises she's a horrible guest. Meanwhile, Freddie is stalked by a criminal whom he catches in the act on video.
Sam and Cat babysit two boys, the first of which likes to ask a lot of questions. Meanwhile, the other can't stop hugging. The girls attempt to save their favourite TV show from being cancelled.
Sam and Cat babysit a goat while trying to win over Dilben, their landlord's obnoxious son who is trying to get the girls evicted. Dice begins managing Goomer, a dim-witted 🥊 [MMA] MMA fighter.

When Alvin accuses Dave of yelling at him too much, a therapist moves in to help Dave control his anger. When the school digs up an old high school time capsule, Miss Smith and Dave work together to keep an old secret.
When Alvin talks Dave into buying a used tour bus, Dave has no idea of the problems ahead. Alvin signs the Chipmunks up for a game show that forces losing contestants to perform dangerous stunts.

Theodore tries to overcome his fear of sleepovers by spending the night at Kevin's house without Alvin or Simon. Plus, when Alvin sees every celebrity with their own personal bodyguard, he decides to train Theodore for the job.
Believing Simon is going away to a boarding school, Alvin and Theodore do all they can to thwart his departure and keep him at home.
When Alvin is paired with Simon for a science project, he accidentally creates a potion that turns Theodore into a 30-foot giant.
Alvin befriends a lonely new kid in school, but Theodore discovers that the new student may not be who he says he is.
Alvin's attempts to make money as an internet influencer almost drive a local toy store out of business.

Alvin and Brittany get stuck alone at the school with a ghost they think roams the halls. Alvin passes off a rock he found on the ground as a meteor for a science project and gets some unwanted attention.

When the boys get stuck with Miss Miller as a babysitter, they each take a crack at finding a replacement. Alvin volunteers to caddy a charity golf tournament and surprisingly gets paired up with Miss Smith.

Alvin and Brittany learn parenting is not easy when they have to care for a robot baby for a school assignment. When Alvin's football team struggles, the coach makes the team learn ballet to help with their conditioning.

Dave, Simon and Theodore are worried about Alvin's safety after Alvin enters a karate contest; when Alvin suspects Simon is Dave's favourite, he and Theo challenge Simon to a go-cart race to win Dave's favour.

When a new boy band, The Hipmunks, tries to steal the spotlight, the Chipmunks are forced to compete in a battle of the bands. The Principal gives Alvin and Derek an ultimatum, if they fight, the school dance will be cancelled.

When Alvin finally pushes Miss Smith too far, she quits and her replacement is a nightmare. Alvin and Simon tease The Chipettes about being scared by a movie so The Chipettes release a video of the boys watching, terrified.

Alvin sneaks into Simon's lab to look at his latest invention, only to accidentally clone himself. With two Alvins, there's double the trouble. Alvin tells a small lie that quickly turns into a huge disaster, dragging everyone into his tangled web.
Alvin convinces Dave to give him his own room; after Alvin inadvertently destroys Theodore's bike, he enters the boys in a round up of shopping carts where the first prize is a new bike.
Alvin gets a lesson in parenting after he kidnaps Simon's robot; when Dave takes away Alvin's phone, the boredom Alvin experiences is enough to drive him crazy.
Theodore becomes frozen like a statue after Alvin scares him. Simon builds a robot bodyguard that helps him stand up to bullies.
Tempers flare when the Chipmunks get stuck in traffic on the way to a show. Simon becomes annoyed by constant requests to fix things and plays dumb until he gets a thank-you.
Miss Croner attempts to help Theodore discover his true calling in life. Jeanette is suddenly the clumsiest person on the planet.
Theodore is passed over when Alvin and Eleanor train as lifeguards; Miss Croner's cherries are lost.
Theodore gets roped into doing Alvin's babysitting job with a spoiled four-year-old. Kevin agrees to be Alvin's assistant to get closer to the music industry, but ends up running errands instead.
Alvin believes a neighbour is responsible for a recent diamond heist. Alvin tries to get out of the annual family day picnic with Dave to go to a big soccer game.

Brittany takes up painting to impress her fashion idol, but her idol only likes her art after Alvin ruins it; Alvin is convinced that Julie and her son are trying to move in to their home, so he tries to stop the invasion.
Theodore's new talking teddy bear drives Alvin and Simon crazy. Alvin is not thrilled about going back to school, until he sees the new principal.
The Chipmunks don't want to perform in the school play, after learning of its curse; Simon's robot Gizmo becomes jealous of Jeanette's robot Zeela, until a sudden tragedy reveals Gizmo's true heart.

Jeanette decides to plant a garden on the school grounds, but Bo Carter manages to install vending machines instead. When Alvin finds a treasure map in Miss Croner's basement, the chipmunks set off in search of lost treasure.
Alvin and Brittany wind up in a battle over popping acorn tops and bubble wrap. When a cute girl joins the chess club, Alvin enlists Jeanette to teach him how to play so he can join as well.
The Chipmunks decide to find Dave a new girlfriend. The Chipmunks accidentally ruin Dave's new song for a music festival.

The boys disobey Dave's orders to not play a dangerous game, then have to hide their injuries when they get hurt. The school newspaper has a sudden increase in sales when a gossip column appears poking fun at other students.

When the girls at school develop a crush on the fire marshal, Alvin decides to be a hero with disastrous results; after causing an accident at a historic castle, Cheesy and Alvin work as reenactors to pay for the damage.

The Chipmunks try to keep Dave from getting on the Internet after a performance he posts gets negative comments. The Chipmunks along with Kevin and Cheesy decide to crash Bo Carter's birthday yacht party after not being invited.

Brittany's dream of being a fashion designer turns into a nightmare when she gets a job and her ideas are stolen. Alvin suspects Dave of being a local bank robber when Dave starts acting suspiciously and giving the boys gifts.
Alvin catches Simon taking a test to discover his soul mate. Simon and Alvin decide to rebel and launch their own campaigns for class president.

When Alvin is paired with Simon to work on a science project, he accidentally creates a potion that turns Theodore into a giant. When all the children's phones go missing at school, Alvin is blamed for the theft and sets out to clear his name.

After Brittany and the girls release a video that goes viral, Alvin, Simon, and Theodore try to top it. Simon falls ill and asks Alvin and Theodore not to go see a new movie without him, but Alvin just cannot resist.

Simon's experiment of how plants respond to positive or negative feedback creates a monster, and it's growing. Brittany's fear of bees turns into admiration when she's shrunk down to their size and experiences life as a bee.

Alvin sneaks into Simon's new virtual reality game and is transported to a world in need of a hero; the chipmunks discover Officer Dangus has a twin brother that's a bully and encourage Dangus to stand up to him.

Theo's funky art project becomes a star with its own social media fans, which is great until the page is hacked; Dave writes a hit love song from a poem he found, but since Simon wrote the poem, he panics his secret will come out.
Brittany's style icon proclaims Jeanette is a fashion trendsetter; Theodore thinks that he is a real superhero.

When Brittany is hurt before a major school event, Jeanette fills in as the Principal's assistant. When Bocarter's father helps him with his class project, Alvin enlists Dave's help, locking the families in a heated competition.

When Theodore's teddy bear, Talking Teddy, gets bear-napped, the boys work with Officer Dangus to get him back. When Alvin starts stealing the morning paper to sell at school, Dave blames the paperboy and refuses to pay up.

When Derek overhears that Alvin and his brothers are alone for the weekend, he plans a wild party at their house. Theodore is hit by lightning and believes he's like his comic book hero, until he's told he's actually a villain.

Gary manages to overcome his jealousy enough to get jeep parts for Ron, but his shopping trip is interrupted by an outbreak of racial tension.

Zeynep vermisst die Berge ihrer Heimat Anatolien, deshalb fahren sie Richtung Süden und landen auf dem Bauernhof von Cheyenne Ochsenknecht und ihrem Mann Nino. Dann geht es auf eine Bayerische Alm. Dort hat sich Tahsim mit Maraam verabredet.
Xaver verliert seine Stelle und muss sein Leben neu ordnen. Kira zweifelt daran, ob Martin das Priesteramt wirklich hätte niederlegen sollen.

Zwischen Marlene und Doris kommt es zu so starken Spannungen, dass Doris Marlene auffordert, aus der Saalfeld-Wohnung auszuziehen. Kira bleibt zunächst im Ungewissen darüber, von wem sie schwanger ist.

Alfons ist beim Überweisen der nächsten Kreditrate ein Missgeschick passiert: Statt 2500 Euro hat er nur 250 Euro überwiesen. Charlotte vertraut ihre Erinnerungen, dass Doris sie sterben lassen wollte, nur Marlene und Julius an.

Nataschas Auftritte im "Fürstenhof" werden reduziert, wodurch sie zunehmend in seelische Not gerät. Die Zwangsversteigerung des Sonnbichler-Hauses ist nicht mehr aufzuhalten. Nach dem Besuch bei der Frauenärztin steht fest, dass Xaver der Vater ist.

Isabelle verliebt sich in den charmanten François, den sie in einer Bar kennengelernt hat. Ihre Romanze wirkt fast zu schön, um wahr zu sein. Doch Éliane weiß sehr viel über den angeblichen Fremden, sodass Zweifel an seiner Identität aufkommen.

Mit einem Geständnis schockiert Louise ihre Töchter. Sie lüftet ein lang gehütetes Geheimnis aus der Vergangenheit, das ihre gemeinsame Zukunft drastisch verändern wird. Die Frage stellt sich, wie sie auf diese Verkündung reagieren werden.
Isabelle und Éliane lernen Michel kennen, Louises neuen alten Liebhaber. Emma macht es sich zur Aufgabe, diesen Neuling zu durchleuchten. Doch diesen Gefallen gibt es nicht umsonst.
Isabelle versucht, Éliane zu trösten, die noch immer unter der Trennung von Benoît leidet. Mylène stattet Isabelle derweil einen unerwarteten Besuch ab. Weiß sie mehr, als Isabelle lieb ist?
Isabelle nutzt die Gelegenheit, um mit JF reinen Tisch zu machen und Missverständnisse zu vermeiden.

Thomas ist in seinem Schmerz außer sich, als Aylins Vater Orkan fordert, sie in der Türkei zu begraben, und entzieht sich jeder freundschaftlichen Fürsorge. Er besteht vehement darauf, dass er bestimmt, wo seine Frau beerdigt wird - bei ihm in Lüneburg. Sebastian stößt Jana vor den Kopf, als sie ihm mit Fragen zu nahe kommt.

Justus erfährt, dass die Sicherheitsanlage der Bank gewartet wird, und will den letzten riskanten Coup allein durchziehen, um danach frei zu sein von seinem Auftraggeber. Als er Merle dies auf einem Zettel gesteht, will sie ihn davon abhalten - und wird unfreiwillig zu seiner Fluchthelferin. Dabei werden Merle und Justus von einem Unbekannten fotografiert.

Die Hörfunkmoderatorin und Journalistin Anke Breitkopf wird mit einem gebrochenen Bein in die Sachsenklinik eingeliefert und operiert. Nach dem Eingriff kommt es zu Komplikationen. In den Armen ihres von ihr getrennt lebenden Ehemannes Raphael, der extra aus Berlin gekommen ist, um sie zu besuchen, bricht sie zusammen. Bei der Patientin wird nun eine Schilddrüsenüberfunktion diagnostiziert. Eine Operation ist notwendig.

Die im fünften Monat schwangere Melanie Steiner und ihre beste Freundin Ursula Bergmann haben sich vorgenommen, Melanies Kind gemeinsam ohne den Vater großzuziehen. Melanie kommt mit Schwindelanfällen in die Klinik, begleitet von Ursula, die von ihr scherzhaft Papa genannt wird. Hier wird über das Lebensmodell der Frauen heftig diskutiert. Nach einem Gespräch mit Kathrin Globisch entscheidet sich Melanie gegen Ursulas Willen dafür, den Kindesvater doch einzuweihen.

Susannes Sohn Jonas ist am Boden zerstört. Angeblich soll er nicht der Vater der Zwillinge sein. Seine Mutter möchte ihm helfen. Susannes Konflikt mit Luisa verschärft sich, als sie ihre Tochter auf einer Demonstration entdeckt.

Im Hause Mertens läuft nicht alles rund. Luisa provoziert Susanne, wo sie kann. Jonas leidet unter der Abwesenheit seiner Kinder. Im Zoo setzt sich Susanne mit Amal auseinander, die von ihren Plänen für die Achterbahn nicht abweichen will.

Sam Hardacre erleidet einen tragischen Unfall, bei dem seine Hand eingequetscht und dabei schwer verletzt wird. Seine Familie ist verzweifelt, denn er wird nicht mehr an den Docks arbeiten können. Ihnen drohen Armut und Obdachlosigkeit.

Die Hardacres beziehen ihr neues Anwesen, doch die adeligen Nachbarn lehnen sie ab. Mutter Mary Hardacre möchte sich einen Platz in der Gesellschaft erkämpfen und gibt eine erste Dinnerparty, bei der jedoch einiges schiefgeht.

Thomas kann in seiner Trauer keine Erinnerungen an Aylin zulassen. Als er Unterstützung bei Gunter sucht, trifft er dort auf Orkan. Die Begegnung überfordert ihn zunächst, doch dann hört er sich zumindest an, warum Aylins Vater darauf besteht, dass seine Tochter in der Türkei beerdigt wird. Als Thomas den Entwurf von Aylins Hochzeitsrede für die Feier in der Türkei findet, brechen schließlich alle Dämme. Endlich kann er um seine geliebte verlorene Frau weinen.

Merle und Justus beschließen, sich nicht weiter erpressen zu lassen. Als ihr Auftraggeber der Kunstdiebstähle keine Ruhe gibt, sehen sie nur eine Möglichkeit für eine gemeinsame Zukunft - sie müssen untertauchen. Aber Merle fragt sich, ob sie wirklich ein Leben lang auf der Flucht sein will, nach dem größten Abenteuer ihres Lebens. Thomas kann endlich die Trauer über Aylins Tod zulassen und willigt ein, dass sie in der Türkei begraben wird.

Hildegard bittet Alfons, ihr Lotterielos abzugeben, dummerweise verliert er seinen Geldbeutel inklusive Spielquittung. Samia ist geschockt, dass Gregor von ihr verlangt, sich von Jana fernzuhalten. Simon stellt ihn zur Rede.

Gregors schlimmste Befürchtungen werden bestätigt und Jana erfährt etwas, was sie ihm vorerst verschweigt. Simon versucht Samia die Schuldgefühle zu nehmen. Hat Pachmeyer den Lotterieschein? André will Charlotte imponieren.

Das Ehepaar Joana und Valentin durchlebt nach 17 Jahren des Zusammenseins eine Beziehungskrise. Unfähig, diese allein zu meistern, beginnen die beiden eine Paartherapie bei Eheberater Harald. Unter seiner Leitung tragen sie lautstark ihre Konflikte aus. Dabei überfordern sie den Experten mit ihrer Sturheit und ihrer Unwilligkeit, aufeinander einzugehen. Ein schicksalhafter Telefonanruf ändert diese Situation jedoch schon bald.

Will und Geordie nehmen endlich ihren dringend benötigten Urlaub im "Merries Holiday Camp". Doch aus den Ferien wird alsbald ein Arbeitsurlaub, als der Besitzer der Camp-Anlage unter mysteriösen Umständen tot aufgefunden wird.

Im Zwist um die Abstammung eines Babys geraten Will und Geordie in einen delikaten Familienstreit, der möglicherweise mit dem Mord am Leiter der örtlichen Adoptionsagentur zusammenhängt. Zwischenzeitlich trifft ein unheimlicher Brief für Leonard ein.

Will und Geordie werden in die heikle Welt der Kommunalpolitik hineingezogen, als der überraschende Tod eines Ratsmitglieds eine Gemeindewahl auslöst. Eine Anschuldigung gegen Leonard stellt unterdessen das Leben im Pfarrhaus auf den Kopf.

Der Afroamerikaner Tupac Shakur lernt von Kindesbeinen an, dass er aufgrund seiner Hautfarbe für seine Rechte kämpfen muss. Er flüchtet sich in die Kunst, rappt, schreibt Poesie und schauspielert. Als Aktivist macht er sich einen Namen und entwickelt sich bald zu einem Superstar der Rap-Szene, der kritische Themen offensiv angeht und großen Einfluss gewinnt. Doch für seine Berühmtheit zahlt er einen hohen Preis.
